items.exampleEn: The kids get presents on their birthdays.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們生日時會得到禮物。

items.exampleEn: My mom makes cakes on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽星期天會做蛋糕。

items.exampleEn: I think it will rain today.
Which pen do you want to take?
I can see the sea from my window.
items.exampleZh: 從我的窗戶可以看到海。

items.exampleEn: Can you come to my party?

items.sentenceEn: I think he knows the answer.

items.audioEn: Come and see my new car! I got it yesterday.
items.audioZh: 快來看我的新車！我昨天拿到的。
items.questionZh: 說話者昨天得到了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Let's go and take some pictures.

items.stemZh: 我不知道他的電話號碼。

items.stemEn: Can you ____ to my house for dinner?

items.passageEn: On Saturday, I go to my grandmother's house. She makes a big lunch for me. After lunch, we take a walk in the park and see many birds. She says, "Come again soon!" I think she is the best grandma in the world.
items.passageZh: 星期六我去奶奶家，她為我煮了一頓豐盛的午餐。午餐後，我們去公園散步，看到很多鳥。她說：「要再來喔！」我覺得她是世界上最好的奶奶。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶為說話者做了什麼？

referenceEn: I don't think he will come today.
I think he won't come today.
rubricZh: 「我想他不會⋯」英文常說 I don't think he will…，寫 I think he won't… 也正確
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will）

referenceEn: What time do you get home?
rubricZh: 「到家」可寫，例如 get home 等，home 前面不加 to
問平常可寫，例如 What time do you…、When do you… 等
問今天這一次可寫，例如 What time will you get home? 等
